spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

surface_styles.dashboard_card: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-transform duration-200
surface_styles.console_panel: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 overflow-hidden relative flex flex-col h-full
surface_styles.glass_header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 sticky top-0 z-50

components.navigation: Sticky sidebar or top navigation using glass_header style. Include branding, breadcrumbs, and user controls.
components.buttons: Rounded-md with subtle scale on click. Active states must have higher contrast.
components.status_badge: Small pill badge with a pulsing dot indicator (Emerald for Running, Red for Stopped, Amber for Starting).
components.tabs: Use shadcn Tabs. Styled with a frosted background or subtle border-bottom active states. Override h-9 to h-auto.
components.console_input: Borderless input field matching the console background, prefixed with a terminal prompt '>'. Focus states should not have ring.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Switch for the Server creation wizard and settings properties.
components.mod_card: Compact bento card displaying Mod icon, name, author, and an 'Install/Remove' button.
components.metric_card: Simple card showing key vitals (RAM, Players, CPU) with a subtle sparkline or simple progress bar.

icons.usage: Use icons for server status, tab navigation (Terminal, Settings, Package, HardDrive), and Start/Stop/Restart controls.

images.description: Minecraft landscape for empty state background or wizard hero area.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Text on elevated surfaces must be clearly legible.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Add aria-hidden='true' to decorative icons.
accessibility.focus: Interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a hybrid fullstack dashboard for a Minecraft Linux Host App.
The UI must be exclusively dark mode (like Aternos), utilizing slate-950, slate-900, and slate-800 for elevation. Pure black is reserved ONLY for the console.
Provide a robust 'Server Dashboard' displaying a list of all servers with their status, RAM usage, and player count.
Implement a 'Create Server' Wizard containing steps for Name, Type (Vanilla/Paper/Fabric/Forge), Version, RAM assignment, and Port.
Build a detailed 'Server View' incorporating tabbed navigation.
Tabs must include: 'Live Console', 'Settings', 'Mods', and 'Backups'. Prominently feature Start/Stop/Restart controls at the top of the detail view.
The 'Live Console' tab must mimic a real terminal: JetBrains Mono font, deep black background, green/white text, scrolling output, and an interactive command input field at the bottom.
The 'Settings' tab should handle numerous server.properties options using appropriate inputs (Shadcn forms, switches for boolean values like pvp and command-blocks, select for difficulty).
The 'Mod-Manager' tab should display a searchable grid of mod cards, allowing users to install or remove mods.
Use .js file extension conventions for all React components, as the project uses .js files, not .tsx.
Do NOT use native HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; strictly use Shadcn components.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and true grey base surfaces (slate).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md or pill) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (Tailwind p-6, p-8) to avoid cramped designs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
